name: GEF Small Grants Programme Morocco
summary: Morocco's GEF Small Grants country programme, run by UNDP, funds civil society and community organisations for landscape-based environmental projects of up to 24 months in three priority landscapes. After the January 2026 deadline it keeps reviewing pipeline proposals until funds run out.
